title: CrY2H-seq interactome screening
protocol: For recombining 96 entry clones, prepare the following master mix in one tube for each plasmid: pADlox or pDBlox plasmid DNA and LR Clonase II Plus enzyme mixture.
Aliquot 4 μl of master mix into each well of a 96-well PCR plate.
Add 1 μl of each different entry clone to each well of the prepared 96-well PCR plate.
Seal the plate very well and vortex briefly to mix. Centrifuge briefly.
Incubate at 25 °C overnight.
Thaw DH5α-T1R chemically competent E. coli cells on ice and aliquot 10 μl of cells into each well of a 96-well PCR plate.

Add 1 μl of LR recombination reaction to competent cells in the 96-well plate without pipetting up and down; instead, seal the plate, gently tap it on the benchtop a few times to mix, then quickly return it to ice.
Incubate on ice for 25 minutes.
Heat shock cells at 42 °C for 30 seconds in a PCR machine.
Place cells back on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 100 μl of SOC to each well and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Inoculate 100 μL of transformation mix into 1 mL of terrific broth supplemented with carbenicillin (50 mg/L) in a 96-well deepwell plate.
Grow overnight at 37 °C with shaking.
Combine 50 μL of 50% glycerol (sterilized) with 100 μL of culture to prepare archival glycerol stock.
Mix well by pipetting up and down.
Seal the prepared glycerol stock plate with foil.
Freeze at -80 °C.
Centrifuge remaining culture at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Discard media by inverting plate over a waste collection bin, then tapping inverted plate on a clean absorbent pad or paper towel.
Follow QIAprep 96 Turbo Miniprep Kit protocol for plasmid preparation.
Measure DNA concentrations using the dsDNA Quantifluor System (Promega) and the 96-well plate reader.
Streak out Y8800 and CRY8930 strains on YEPD and YEPD supplemented with hygromycin (125 mg/L) media respectively.
Incubate at 30 °C for 48 hours to obtain isolated colonies.
Inoculate 20 mL of YEPD with at least 10 isolated colonies for each strain.
Incubate inoculated cultures at 30 °C with shaking overnight.
Measure and record OD600, which should be between 4.0 to 6.0.
Dilute cells with YEPD to a final OD600 of 0.1-0.2.
Aim for 100 mL of YEPD per 96-well plate.
Incubate at 30 °C with shaking until the OD600 reaches 0.6-0.8 and cells have undergone two doublings.
Boil salmon sperm DNA for 5 minutes.
Place boiled salmon sperm DNA on ice until needed.
Pellet cells at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Discard media and wash cells in 10 mL sterile water per 96-well plate.
Resuspend cells in 10 mL 1x LiAc/TE solution per 96-well plate.
Pellet cells at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in 2 mL 1x LiAc/TE solution per 96-well plate.
Add 10 mL Lithium Acetate/Tris EDTA/PEG solution and 200 μL salmon sperm DNA per 96-well plate.
Gently invert cells to mix.
Pipette 120 μL of cell solution into each well in a 96-well v-bottom plate.
Pipette 10 μL of plasmid DNA into the cell solution.
Seal plates with a sealer or foil.
Vortex plates briefly to mix plasmid DNA with cell solution.
Tap plate gently on benchtop to ensure mixing.
Incubate plate at 42 °C for 1 hour in a benchtop incubator.
Pellet cells at 1500 rpm and discard transformation mix by inverting the plate over a waste collection bin.
Tap inverted plate a few times on a clean absorbent pad or paper towel.
Add 100 μL sterile water to each well to wash pellets.
Pellet cells at 1500 rpm, remove sterile water from each well by gently inverting plates over a waste collection bin.
Resuspend pellets in residual sterile water in each well.
Spot 5 μL of transformation on 1x SC –Leu media for bait strains or 1x SC –Trp media for prey strains.
Grow spotted media at 30 °C for 3 days.
Pick colonies into 200 μL per well of 1x SC –Leu or 1x SC –Trp liquid media and grow to saturation for 2 to 3 days with shaking at 30 °C.
Combine 50 μL of culture with 50 μL of 50% glycerol (sterilized) in a tube.
Mix well by pipetting up and down.
Seal the tube with foil and freeze it at -80 °C.
Combine 50 μL of each prey strain culture into a sterile trough.
Do the same for bait strain cultures.
Prepare 1 mL aliquots of at least 3 OD<sub>600</sub>, mix with 500 μL of 50% glycerol.
Store the mixture at -80 °C.
Grow Y8800 strain with empty pADlox in 10 mL 1x SC –TRP at 30 °C for 2 days with shaking prior to screening.
Thaw at least 20 OD<sub>600</sub> of each library and inoculate into 200 mL YEPD liquid media.
Grow the cultures for 1 hour at 30 °C with shaking.
Measure OD<sub>600</sub> of each library.
Combine 20 OD<sub>600</sub> of each library, pellet cells, and discard media.
Resuspend cells in 13.5 mL YEPD and aliquot 1.5 mL across 1.5 6-well culture plates.
Incubate at 30 °C shaking at 50 rpm for 4.5 hours.
Combine 1.5 mL aliquots back together in one 50 mL tube.
Reserve a 10 μL aliquot for calculating mating efficiency.
Pellet mate culture and resuspend in 100 mL 1x SC –Leu/-Trp supplemented with 125 g/mL hygromycin.
Grow at 30 °C overnight shaking at 150 rpm.
Plate serial dilutions of 10 μL mate culture reserved aliquot on 1x SC –Leu, 1x SC –Trp, and 1x SC –Leu/-Trp.
Incubate for 3 days at 30 °C and count colonies to calculate mating efficiency.
Pellet cells at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Wash cells with 1x SC.
Pellet cells at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in sterile water to a final concentration of 1 OD<sub>600</sub> per mL.
Plate 500 μL of cells per plate on 1x SC –Leu/-Trp/-His + 1 mM 3-AT.
Grow for 3 days at 30 °C.
Collect cells by pipetting 3.5 mL of deionized distilled water onto each selection plate, then move plates in a circular motion to suspend all colonies.
Transfer collected cells across two wells of a 96-well deepwell plate using the lid back on the original dish for guidance.
Seal plates tightly and heat inactivate cells at 75 °C for 20 minutes in a water bath.
Pellet cells at 3000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C, then discard supernatant by first inverting the plate over a waste bin and tapping it on an absorbent pad or paper towel.
Add 300 μL of yeast lysis buffer to each well and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour at 50 rpm.
Carry out plasmid preparation using the QIAprep 96 Turbo Miniprep Kit protocol, omitting P1 resuspension buffer since cells are already in yeast lysis buffer.
Use double volumes of buffers P2 and P3 during plasmid purification.
Include a wash step with buffer PB, and pre-heat buffer EB to 70 °C for DNA elution from the QIAprep membrane.
Measure DNA concentrations using the dsDNA Quantifluor System and the 96-well plate reader.
Prepare the master mix for amplifying Cre-recombined ORF products in one tube (x100 for 1 96-well plate).
Aliquot 23 μL of master mix into each well of a 96-well PCR plate on ice.
Add 2 μL of yeast miniprep to each well containing the master mix.
Seal the PCR plate with adhesive aluminum foil.
Place the PCR plate in a thermocycler and run the program: Denature at 98 °C for 2 minutes.
Denature at 98 °C for 10 seconds.
Annel at 65 °C for 30 seconds.
Extend at 72 °C for 90 seconds.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 for a total of 21 cycles.
Perform a final extension at 72 °C for 7 minutes.
Hold the plate at 10 °C.
Load 5 μL of each PCR product onto a 1% agarose 1x TAE gel.
Run the gel at 100 V for 30-40 minutes.
Pool PCR reactions and concentrate DNA by performing a QIAquick column clean up or isopropanol precipitation.
Purify PCR products from primers with two rounds of purification using SeraMag Speedbeads at a 1:1 bead to DNA ratio.
Fragment amplicon DNA to 300 bp with a Covaris S2 sonicator.
Perform QIAquick column clean up or isopropanol precipitation to remove small fragments, then elute or resuspend in 34 μL EB.

Prepare end-repair reaction by combining 34 μL of DNA with 5 μL 10x End-it buffer, 5 μL 10 mM dNTP mix, 5 μL ATP, and 1 μL End-it enzyme mix. Mix gently, spin quickly, and incubate at 22 °C for 45 minutes.
Perform QIAquick column clean up or isopropanol precipitation to remove small fragments, then elute or resuspend in 32 μL EB.

Prepare a-tail reaction by combining 32 μL DNA with 5 μL Klenow buffer (NEB Buffer 2), 10 μL 1 mM dATP, and 3 μL Klenow Fragment 3’-->5’ exo- (NEB). Mix gently, spin quickly, and incubate at 37 °C for 30 minutes.
Perform QIAquick column clean up or isopropanol precipitation to remove small fragments, then elute or resuspend in 38 μL EB.

Prepare adapter ligation reactions by combining 37.5 μL of DNA with 5 μL of 10x DNA ligase buffer with ATP (NEB), 5 μL Truseq DNA adapter index (Illumina), and 2.5 μL T4 DNA ligase (NEB). Mix gently, spin quickly, and incubate at 16 °C overnight.
Run ligation reaction out on a 2% agarose gel and excise between 400-600 bp.
Purify using QIAquick gel extraction kit and elute in 25 μL EB.
Combine 23.5 μL DNA with 0.5 μL Phusion polymerase (NEB).
Add 10 μL 5xGC buffer (NEB) to the mixture.
Include 10 μL 5 M Betaine in the reaction.
Mix in 1 μL dNTPs (10 mM each).
Pipette 5 μL Truseq multiplexing PCR primer cocktail (Illumina) into the mix.
Place the PCR plate on a thermocycler.
Denature at 98 °C for 2 minutes.
Denature at 98 °C for 10 seconds.
Anneal at 62 °C for 30 seconds.
Extend at 72 °C for 30 seconds.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 for a total of 3 times.
Perform final extension at 72 °C for 5 minutes.
Hold the PCR plate at 10 °C.
Purify PCR products from primers with SeraMag Speedbeads at a 1:1 bead to DNA ratio.
Quantify the purified amplified library using a Qubit fluorometric quantitation kit.
Map reads using Bowtie2-2.0.2 local alignment with default settings to a custom genome.
Apply quality filter requiring reads to map with at least 30 matching bases, allowing up to 2 mismatches and 2 insertions or deletions, and trimming up to 2 bases from the start of the read.
Join reads with their corresponding read pairs for further analysis if both reads passed the initial filter and mapped to Arabidopsis TF ORF sequences.
Remove clonal fragments if both reads in a fragment have the same start positions.
Include paired reads in further analysis only if each mate aligned to a different ORF and showed the same strand orientation.
Apply size filter requiring the sum of read lengths plus lox region length to conform to 400-600bp library size.
Total fragments mapping to ORF junction regions.
